description: Add a new AI provider for brainstorming. Supports any OpenAI-compatible API, or a locally installed agent CLI (kind='cli') that runs on an existing subscription instead of API credits.

adapter.description: cli only: built-in adapter — claude, codex, gemini, qwen, kimi, cursor-agent, opencode, droid — or 'custom'. Defaults to the provider name.

apiKeyEnvVar.description: api only: environment variable holding the API key. Use 'NONE' if no key required.

args.description: cli only ('custom' adapter): argv template. Placeholders: {{model}}, {{system}}, {{prompt}}, {{outfile}}.

backend.description: cli only: run the Claude CLI against another vendor's coding plan — moonshot, minimax, glm. Overrides 'adapter'.

baseURL.description: api only: base URL, e.g. 'http://localhost:11434/v1' for Ollama

command.description: cli only: executable to run. Required for adapter 'custom'.

defaultModel.description: Default model for this provider, e.g. 'llama3', 'sonnet'. Use 'default' to let a CLI pick its own.

kind.description: 'api' (default) for an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint, 'cli' for a local agent CLI.

promptVia.description: cli only ('custom' adapter): how the prompt reaches the CLI.

name: add_provider
